points.quote: They sit next to the code in `src/vs/**/test/` folders, in `browser/`, `node/` and `common/` subfolders.
Run them with `scripts/test.sh` or `scripts\test.bat`. Useful options are `--run <file>` and `--grep`.
`npm run test-browser` runs them in Playwright, and `npm run test-node` runs the node ones with mocha.
Many of the tests live in `src/**/test/**/*.integrationTest.*` files. Run them with `scripts/test-integration.sh`.
They live inside `extensions/*`, including `vscode-api-tests`. ... The integration scripts also run them.
These are UI end-to-end tests in `test/smoke`. They drive the app through the `test/automation` library, which uses Playwright or Electron. Run them with `npm run smoketest`
The runner infrastructure is in `test/unit/` ... The runners are in `test/integration/electron` ... `test/smoke` ... They are in `test/sanity`.
